claims.statement: For real sequences h,p : Nat → Real with h tending to 0 through positive values and p tending to p₀, if q < p₀ then Real.rpow (h n) (p n) / Real.rpow (h n) q tends to 0; if p₀ < q then the same ratio tends to atTop. No cube or boundedness assumption is imposed on p n.
assumptions: A strict real gap q < p₀ or p₀ < q
claims.novelty_boundary: Formal proof of a standard asymptotic ingredient only; this does not establish the affine approximation theorem, application claims, or novelty.
claims.costs: One local Lean 4.28.0 compilation against the existing compiled mathlib v4.28.0 cache; no download or external project write.
claims.falsifier: A Lean compilation or kernel audit failure, or a counterexample sequence satisfying the exact convergence and strict-gap hypotheses.
claims.next_gate: Use the exported ratio lemmas in the shared affine-candidate Lean development and compile the full argument.

claims.novelty_boundary: One formalized competing-label estimate only; no claim about the complete affine theorem, empirical applications, or novelty.
